metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Burhan Shaheen.

plugins.name: grove
plugins.description: Git worktrees made easy: a band above the prompt to switch, diff, review, compare and commit, one chat per worktree, shared node_modules, and guards that keep agents in their own worktree.

plugins.name: wlog
plugins.description: Never forget what you worked on. Builds a work log from your Claude Code chats and your own git commits, with a 1-page PDF and a shareable page.
